targets.title: Check runner rerun rate on main
targets.subject: error contract
targets.statement: At most 5 percent of the sampled check-runner workflow runs on main needed a rerun attempt, so a failure reported by the runner is an observation and not noise.

targets.title: Green main success rate
targets.subject: error contract
targets.statement: At least 95 percent of the sampled workflow runs on main conclude successfully, so a red run on main is a real error rather than the steady state.

targets.title: Robustness test share
targets.subject: error contract
targets.statement: At least 10 percent of the declared test files exercise error, retry, timeout, or fallback behavior, so the error contract is observed by tests and not only declared.

targets.title: Inventory regeneration determinism
targets.subject: error contract
targets.statement: Two regenerations of the inventory at the same head produce byte-identical canonical output, reported as equal 1 by the inventory determinism sensor.
